name: linear-precision
title: Linear Precision
description: Obsidian dark craft with adjacent neutral surfaces, translucent luminance hairlines, compact type, and tabular operational precision.

typography.fontFamily: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

rules: Build elevation from adjacent neutral surfaces and one-pixel luminance borders before adding shadow.
Reserve indigo for primary actions, current selection, and keyboard focus—not decorative washes.
Keep product UI compact at 13–16px while preserving 1.45–1.6 body line-height.
Use tabular figures for metrics, timestamps, identifiers, issue counts, and financial values.
Align labels, controls, and values to shared edges on the four-pixel grid.
Prefer 6px and 8px radii; reserve full radii for compact status pills and avatars.
Never introduce neon glows, glass blur, purple gradients, or ambient floating animation.
Focus rings must remain visible against every dark surface and finish without layout shift.
Use 32–40px control heights and explicit hover, active, disabled, and loading states.
Direct manipulation feedback should complete within 140ms and disappear under reduced motion.
